enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Sleep. Turn to left side. Sleep. Turn to right side. Sleep. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Stretch legs. Sleep. Turn over. Sleep. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, using the toilet, showering and washing
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Lift toilet lid. Urinate. Flush toilet. Lower toilet lid. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse. Apply shampoo. Wash hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wash hands. Turn off tap.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle and toasting bread
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out bread. Take out butter. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Press lever. Open cupboard. Take out plate. Take out knife. Fill kettle with water. Plug in kettle. Turn on kettle. Wait for toast. Toast pops up. Remove toast. Put on plate. Butter toast. Pour boiling water into cup. Add tea bag. Stir. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Dressing in work clothes, packing bag and checking the phone for shift notes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out trousers. Put on shirt. Put on trousers. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out bag. Open bag. Place stethoscope in bag. Place notebook in bag. Place pen in bag. Close bag. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open notes app. Read shift notes. Lock phone. Put phone in pocket.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of bedroom. Walk to front door. Open door. Step outside. Close door. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone. See bus approaching. Board bus. Pay fare. Walk to seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional: patient care, clinical rounds, charting and handover
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at hospital. Change into scrubs. Attend handover meeting. Listen to report. Take notes. Go on clinical rounds. Visit patient rooms. Check patient vital signs. Talk to patients. Administer medication. Update patient charts. Attend team meeting. Discuss patient cases. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Continue patient care. Chart patient progress. Prepare for handover. Give handover report.
Leave hospital. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and changing out of work clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Take off work clothes. Place in hamper. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel. Walk to bedroom. Put on clean clothes.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Cook. Turn off stove. Serve on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up the kitchen and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Clear table. Scrape plates into trash. Rinse plates. Open dishwasher. Load plates. Load glasses. Load utensils. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe counters. Wipe table. Sweep floor.

enriched_activities.activity: Researching the new rooftop solar subsidy on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Open browser. Type search query. Click on links. Read articles. Take notes. Scroll down. Click on next page. Open new tab.
Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Press channel up. Press channel down. Press volume up. Press volume down. Press mute. Unmute. Change to streaming service. Select movie. Play. Pause. Resume.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening hygiene routine: brushing teeth, washing face and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face with cleanser. Rinse. Dry face. Apply moisturizer. Floss teeth. Rinse.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down in bed, reading and checking the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on bedside lamp. Get into bed. Pick up book. Read pages. Put down book. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Check messages. Open social media. Scroll. Lock phone. Put phone on nightstand.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Sleep. Turn to left side. Sleep. Turn to right side. Sleep. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Stretch legs. Sleep. Turn over. Sleep.
